title: Copper Grate Forge
description:
A small mod that adds a new block called "copper grate forge" that acts as a decoration block!


But I also aim to add a functionality, So if someone wants to suggest me how to add functionality and solve bugs, Contact me
body:
**Copper Grate Forge**
By Codex

Add a touch of rustic glow to your Minecraft world with the Copper Grate Forge!
The Copper Grate Forge is your brand new decorative block, perfect for adding an industrial-chic aesthetic to your builds. Crafted with intricate copper details, this block brings a unique visual element to any workshop, mine, or cozy corner you can imagine.

Currently, the Copper Grate Forge serves as a beautiful and functional light source, emitting a warm and inviting glow at light level 10. Illuminate your darkest caverns or simply enhance the ambiance of your favorite builds with its radiant presence.

**What's Next? (Future Plans!)**
While the Copper Grate Forge is currently a decorative and light-emitting block, it's designed with future expansions in mind! We have exciting plans to introduce new functionalities that will transform this humble block into a valuable tool for your in-game adventures. Stay tuned for updates that will unlock its full potential!

**Support & Connect**
If you love the Copper Grate Forge, consider leaving a heart or star on Modrinth! Your support helps us immensely.
